name: Generate Studio Demo
tagline: Text-to-image and image-to-image with your own checkpoint and LoRAs.

scopeJustifications.ai:write:budgeted: Runs the text-to-image and image-to-image generations the viewer starts, spending their Buzz up to this app's per-generation limit; also lists, cancels and (after a confirm) publishes the generations this app made for them.
scopeJustifications.buzz:read:self: Reads the viewer's Buzz balance to tell them before spending whether they can afford a generation, and how much to top up if not.
